summary: Comprehensive architectural audit, offline hardening plan, and Electron desktop packaging specification for SUPER PIXEL WORLD. Details Phase 1 offline asset decoupling (local WOFF2 fonts, relative Vite paths, LocalStorage safety), Phase 2 Electron architecture (secure context-isolated main process, privileged 'app://' protocol for zero-CORS audio streaming, ASAR unpacking strategy, NSIS installer config), Phase 3 terminal build commands, and a Senior Game Architect evaluation (8.5/10).
